from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
NS={'m':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main','r':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'}
for p in [Path('inputs/Proteomic_data .xlsx'),Path('inputs/MeRIP_RNA_result.xlsx')]:
    print('\\nFILE',p.name)
    with ZipFile(p) as z:
        wb=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
        print('sheets:', [s.attrib.get('name') for s in wb.find('m:sheets',NS)])
        sh=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
        dim=sh.find('m:dimension',NS)
        print('dimension:', dim.attrib if dim is not None else None)
        ss=[]
        if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
            root=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
            for si in root.findall('m:si',NS):
                ss.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{%s}t'%NS['m'])))
        rows=[]
        for row in sh.findall('.//m:sheetData/m:row',NS)[:8]:
            vals=[]
            for c in row.findall('m:c',NS):
                v=c.find('m:v',NS)
                val='' if v is None else (ss[int(v.text)] if c.attrib.get('t')=='s' else v.text)
                vals.append((c.attrib.get('r'),val))
            rows.append(vals)
        for x in rows: print(x)
